title: NCP: Verifier-Guided Optimization of Weight-Space Control Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.13236v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present the Neural Control Plane (NCP), a closed-loop system that observes language-model execution, synthesizes candidate weight-space intervention rules, evaluates them, and maintains a versioned table of admitted policies. NCP separates a pretrained model's inference data plane from the control policy that selects temporary parameter interventions. W-ISA supplies transactional execution and parameter restoration; NCP supplies telemetry, candidate synthesis, admission criteria, priorities, and rule lifetime management. The optimization state consists of active rules and an archive of evaluated candidates, while base-model parameters are restored after each request. In a local SmolLM-135M-Instruct experiment, NCP generated three candidates from development telemetry and evaluated them on separate task examples and a 4,095-target WikiText-2 slice. translated_title: NCP：验证器引导的权重空间控制策略优化
translated_abstract: 我们提出了神经控制平面（Neural Control Plane, NCP），这是一个闭环系统，能够观察语言模型的执行过程、合成候选的权重空间干预规则、对其进行评估，并维护一个已采纳策略的版本化表格。NCP 将预训练模型的推理数据平面与选择临时参数干预的控制策略分离开来。W-ISA 提供事务性执行和参数恢复；NCP 提供遥测、候选合成、准入标准、优先级设置和规则生命周期管理。优化状态由活跃规则和已评估候选的存档组成，而基础模型参数在每个请求之后都会被恢复。在本地 SmolLM-135M-Instruct 实验中，NCP 从开发遥测数据中生成了三个候选规则，并在独立的任务样例和一个包含 4,095 个目标的 WikiText-2 切片上进行了评估。其中一个投影将验证集的 token 重复率从 0.4133 降低到 0.2191，困惑度（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出神经控制平面（NCP），一种闭环系统，将预训练模型的推理数据平面与控制策略分离，自动合成、评估并管理临时的权重空间干预规则，同时通过基础模型参数的可恢复性保证安全，实验中成功将 SmolLM-135M 的验证集 token 重复率从 0.4133 降至 0.2191。
en_tdlr: NCP introduces a closed-loop Neural Control Plane that separates a pretrained model's inference data plane from an automatically optimized control policy—synthesizing, evaluating, and managing temporary weight-space intervention rules with restorable base parameters—reducing validation token repetition on SmolLM-135M from 0.4133 to 0.2191.
